name: Good Works
overview: Scripture teaches that good works are the natural fruit of a believer’s new life in Christ, created by God to walk in the good works He has prepared for us (Ephesians 2:10). While salvation is by grace through faith and not by our own efforts (Ephesians 2:8), believers are called to live out their faith actively, letting their good works shine before others to glorify God (Matthew 5:16). The pursuit of good works involves diligent, wholehearted service as unto the Lord (Colossians 3:23) and perseverance in doing what is right, trusting that in due time God will bring about a harvest (Galatians 6:9). Even in seeking to understand what it means to do God’s works, believers are directed to align their actions with His will (John 6:28).
